description: This file defines an abstract base class for relationship plugins in Drupal's Views module, including methods for initialization, option definition, query building, and dependency calculation.

classes.name: RelationshipPluginBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for relationship handlers in Drupal Views, providing core functionality for managing relationships between tables.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the relationship plugin, setting the table and realField based on the definition.

methods.name: usesGroupBy
methods.description: Indicates whether the relationship uses GROUP BY in SQL; returns FALSE.

methods.name: defineOptions
methods.description: Defines default options for the relationship, including label and required flag.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the form for configuring relationship options, including a checkbox for 'Require this relationship'.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds the SQL query for the relationship, creating join instances and managing relationship aliases.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates module dependencies based on the base table provider.
